svg.text: Part 1: domain model (Mongoose models) Part 2: application classes (controllers, middleware, utilities)
The backend is plain JavaScript (CommonJS modules + Mongoose schemas), not an OO class hierarchy.
The three entities are the Mongoose models. User is ONE class with a role field (applicant, company,
admin); the fields tagged applicant / company / admin only apply to that role. There are no subclasses.
Associations are ObjectId references resolved in code with populate(). MongoDB does not enforce them,
and there are no foreign keys or transactions. Arrow = holds the reference; numbers = multiplicity.
Application.company is a copy of Job.company, set when the application is created.
Filled diamond = composition: statusHistory[] is embedded inside each Application document.
Dashed arrow = the attribute uses that enumeration. {unique} = unique index in MongoDB.
PART 2 - APPLICATION CLASSES (controllers, middleware and utilities)
allows only the listed roles, else 403
sends the OTP e-mail with Nodemailer
Controllers call the Mongoose models of Part 1 directly. The code has no separate service or repository layer, so none is drawn.
